scope: Route observation TTL propagation; no new provider calls or budget-counter changes

python.rest_and_mcp: Fresh route parsing stamps the actual response observation; declared provider timestamps are retained and TTL-capped. MCP normalization preserves timestamps if provided
python.memory_cache: The solver keeps original observation metadata alongside existing two-element duration/verified tuples
python.checkpoint: Each persisted route includes original observed_at and expires_at; restoration never assigns now to a saved route
python.day_output: route_fact_expires_at carries a conservative minimum over route evidence seen while solving that day
python.expiry_during_solve: Expiry is checked again after the solver returns, before feasibility classification
python.legacy_without_observation: Retain the old duration for comparison, mark unverified and emit an expired deadline; do not silently make another provider request
python.saved_day: A saved day must retain a still-current route deadline to be reused

java.cache: AmapGateway puts observation and expiry into the initial route cache value; cache hits return a copy without renewing them
java.quality: PlanRules retains route observation metadata in route legs and takes a non-renewing minimum into day.route_fact_expires_at
java.schedule_binding: Root-owned ScheduleDependencies must also min the returned route_fact_expires_at with other dependency expiry

python_cases: Near-expiry provider fact survives checkpoint recovery, then becomes unverified without renewal or another send
Legacy checkpoint missing observation cannot receive a fresh thirty-minute lifetime
tests.java_status: Handed to root for serial Maven; no claim of completion until that run
tests.synthetic_fixture_note: The old hotel-matrix replay test now explicitly injects synthetic fresh observation metadata in memory to test hotel logic; historical JSON evidence is unchanged and runtime restoration never does this
